title: Setting up crops: direct seeding and transplanting
summary: Seedbed preparation, loosening with a broadfork, leveling, sowing in regular rows, and stress-free transplanting for young seedlings.

pages.title: Preparing the growing beds
pages.text:
Before sowing or transplanting, it is essential to prepare your growing beds properly. With well-aerated, leveled and labeled beds, you will:

- Promote optimal plant growth.
- Simplify the organization of your plot.

Here, we are working with permanent growing beds that are **10 meters long and 75 cm wide**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Préparer les planches de culture

pages.title: Step 1: How to aerate the bed properly
pages.text: The first step of preparation: check how loose your soil is and learn how to aerate it deeply without turning it over.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 1 : Comment bien aérer la planche ?

pages.title: Checking aeration and using the broadfork
pages.text:
Check that the bed is well aerated: the soil should be **loose and crumbly**.

If the soil is compacted, use the **broadfork**, pushing it deep into the soil to aerate it.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Vérifier l’aération et utiliser la grelinette

pages.title: The benefits of the broadfork
pages.text:
Using a broadfork means **working the soil deeply without turning it over**. This allows:

- Compost to be incorporated into the bed.
- Better water penetration.
- Deeper root development.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Les bénéfices de la grelinette

pages.title: A living soil and deep roots
pages.text:
By aerating the soil without inverting it, the broadfork preserves the natural structure of the soil and promotes:

- Incorporation of compost into the bed.
- Better water penetration.
- Deeper root development.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Un sol vivant et des racines en profondeur

pages.title: Step 2: How to level the bed properly
pages.text: Second step: learn how to even out the surface of the bed to obtain a clean, regular seedbed.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 2 : Comment bien niveler la planche ?

pages.title: Using the fine-toothed rake
pages.text:
Use the **fine-toothed rake** to level the bed and remove large debris such as stones, plant residues or plastics.

This ensures a **uniform distribution of water** across the bed, which promotes even crop development.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Passer le râteau fin

pages.title: Checking soil moisture before leveling
pages.text:
Make sure your soil is not too wet before raking.

⚠️ **Warning**: if you notice that the soil sticks to the teeth of the rake, it is too wet. Wait until it has dried out sufficiently before working the bed.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Vérifier l’humidité du sol avant de niveler

pages.title: Step 3: How to label your bed
pages.text: Third step: clearly identify each bed to ensure rigorous monitoring of your crops.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 3 : Comment étiqueter votre planche ?

pages.title: Preparing a durable label
pages.text:
To keep good track of your crops, each bed must be clearly identified with a label.

**Prepare the label:**

- Use available materials, such as pieces of wood, metal or plastic plates.
- Write the information with a marker that is resistant to water and sun.
- You can also use a pencil, or engrave the information so that it does not fade.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Préparer une étiquette durable

pages.title: The information to write on the label
pages.text:
Indicate the following information on the label:

- **Bed number**: for example, number the beds from 1 to 10 for a plot with 10 beds.
- **Planting date**: note the exact date of sowing or transplanting.
- **Crop name and variety**: specify the species and variety grown.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Les informations à inscrire sur l’étiquette

pages.title: Placing the label on the bed
pages.text: Place the label **at the head of the bed**, in a clearly visible spot, so that you can immediately identify each crop when you walk through the plot.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Installer l’étiquette sur la planche

pages.title: Conclusion: beds ready for planting
pages.text:
**Congratulations!** Proper bed preparation improves soil fertility, makes irrigation easier and optimizes crop growth.

By following these steps, you ensure ideal conditions for healthy and abundant harvests.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Conclusion : des planches prêtes pour la culture
